Spill-free ink bottles refill the printer tanks without mess or wasted ink.

Print Speed and Resolution

The Epson printer prints black text at up to 33 pages per minute and color pages at up to 15 pages per minute. Print resolution reaches 5760 by 1440 dpi for crisp lines and clear color transitions. First print output takes just 10 seconds in color and 16 seconds in black. Borderless printing up to 4R suits quick photo prints at home. With this Epson EcoTank L3210 printer, everyday printing is fast without sacrificing document quality.

Ultra-Low-Cost Ink Tank Printing

Epson's EcoTank system replaces cartridges with refillable ink bottles for lower cost per page. Scan and Copy Capabilities

The Epson EcoTank L3210 printer has a flatbed color image scanner that handles both documents and photos. Scan resolution reaches 600 by 1200 dpi, completing black scans in 11 seconds and color scans in 32 seconds. Copy speed reaches 7 pages per minute in black and 1.7 pages per minute in color at 600 by 600 dpi resolution. Manual duplex scanning and printing add flexibility for double-sided documents.

Paper Handling and Compatibility

The Epson printer accepts a wide range of paper sizes, including A4, Letter, Legal, and several envelope formats. The input tray holds up to 100 sheets of plain paper or 20 sheets of premium glossy photo paper. Output capacity reaches 30 sheets of plain paper. Standard 80 g/m2 paper weight keeps costs predictable for regular printing. This Epson EcoTank L3210 printer range of supported sizes suits both home documents and small business paperwork.

Compact Design and USB Connectivity

The Epson EcoTank L3210 connects to computers through a simple USB interface. Its compact footprint suits desks and shelves with limited space, without giving up core multifunction features. Power consumption stays low at 14 watts during operation and drops to 0.4 watts in sleep mode. The Epson printer works with Windows XP through Windows 10 and Mac OS X 10.6.8 or later, covering most home and office setups.

Duty Cycle and Reliability

The Epson EcoTank L3210 printer supports a monthly duty cycle of up to 1,500 pages, suited to regular home or small office printing volumes. Consistent print quality holds steady across that workload without frequent maintenance. The Epson printer's simple ink refill process keeps downtime low between ink changes. This reliability makes the L3210 a practical all-in-one printer for daily document and photo printing needs.

Why Choose the Epson EcoTank L3210

The Epson EcoTank L3210 suits anyone who prints regularly and wants to cut ink costs. Print, scan, and copy functions cover most home and small office needs in one device. The HP Color LaserJet Pro MFP 4303fdn is a powerhouse multifunction Laser printer engineered for modern businesses that demand speed, precision, and vibrant color output without compromising on security or efficiency. Designed to support high-volume workflows, this all-in-one solution combines printing, scanning, copying, and faxing into a single compact unit, making it ideal for small to medium-sized offices, workgroups, and enterprise teams. The 4303fdn is HP’s Jet Intelligence toner technology, which ensures crisp text, rich graphics, and consistent color across every page while optimizing toner usage for lower operational costs. With print speeds of up to 35 pages per minute (ppm) and automatic duplex printing, users can tackle large jobs quickly and reduce paper waste. The 250-sheet input tray, 100-sheet multipurpose tray, and 50-sheet automatic document feeder (ADF) streamline bulk tasks, while the flatbed scanner supports high-resolution scans for documents, IDs, and marketing materials. Connectivity is seamless thanks to Gigabit Ethernet, Hi-Speed USB 2.0, and compatibility with HP Smart Admin—a centralized dashboard that simplifies fleet management, remote monitoring, and user access control. The HP Color LaserJet Pro MFP 4303fdn printer also supports advanced security protocols, including PIN printing, secure boot, and firmware integrity checks, ensuring sensitive data stays protected in shared environments. Built for durability, the HP 4303fdn boasts a monthly duty cycle of up to 55,000 pages, making it a reliable choice for demanding office settings.
